Find applicable evidence-backed ways to reduce execution time in this GitHub Actions workflow. Consider its jobs, dependencies, commands, triggers, and repository manifests.
# Continuous integration handling for Go
name: ci-go

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/ci-go.yml
      - .golangci.yml
      - go.mod
      - '**.go'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  golangci-lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e # v7.0.0
        with:
          go-version-file: 'go.mod'
      - run: go mod download
      - uses: golangci/golangci-lint-action@ba0d7d2ec06a0ea1cb5fa41b2e4a3ab91d21278a # v9.3.0
        with:
          version: latest
  terraform-provider-corner-tfprotov5:
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: terraform-provider-corner
    name: terraform-provider-corner (tfprotov5 / Terraform ${{ matrix.terraform}})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          path: terraform-provider-corner
          repository: hashicorp/terraform-provider-corner
      - uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e # v7.0.0
        with:
          go-version-file: 'go.mod'
      - uses: hashicorp/setup-terraform@dfe3c3f87815947d99a8997f908cb6525fc44e9e # v4.0.1
        with:
          terraform_version: ${{ matrix.terraform }}
          terraform_wrapper: false
      - run: go mod edit -replace=github.com/hashicorp/terraform-plugin-sdk/v2=../
      - run: go mod tidy
      - run: go test -v ./internal/sdkv2provider
        env:
          TF_ACC: '1'
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        terraform: ${{ fromJSON(vars.TF_VERSIONS_PROTOCOL_V5) }}
  test:
    name: test (Go v${{ matrix.go-version }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        go-version: ['1.26', '1.27']
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e # v7.0.0
        with:
          go-version: ${{ matrix.go-version }}
      - run: go mod download
      - run: go test -coverprofile=coverage.out ./...
      - run: go tool cover -html=coverage.out -o coverage.html
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: go-${{ matrix.go-version }}-coverage
          path: coverage.html

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
